description.en:
What if you could see your future boyfriend that you didn't even know of..?   
The school romance of a girl who can see the future.

I was reborn into a romance fiction novel. I am lowborn, but there are plenty of boys here, and I get to work for the nobles.
But there’s a tiny problem. 

This noble family happens to be a family of villains, and I’m supposed to lead these serpents and throw the empire into chaos. Apparently, I am the greatest villain in this novel!

The deaths, the chaos in the empire, and the matters of inheritance locked the duke’s children and me into a corner of the manor. But the novel never mentioned anything about being locked away. So here, I must survive and grow… for a villainous happily ever after.

I’ve gone into the body of ‘Ninaina’, the weakest character, who was fated to die once winter came!

With such with weak stamina that it’s hard to even take walks, eat, or just stand, let alone exercise, I have such a tragic life that I even have to endure assassination attempts from my grandfather…

“I will definitely recover my health!”

“Kaiser” who comes to Ninaina’s side with a cold gaze. Receiving the order that he has to keep Ninaina alive, he comes to her side and protects her.

“You will not die. For now.”

---
Ninenya Seiah’s misfortunes began from birth, owing to her mother’s traitorous reputation and subsequent death. Ninenya was thus banished from the noble Seiah family and forcibly separated from her father, Lord Rubenio Seiah. In extremely poor health, Ninenya has mere months to live. To save his daughter, Rubenio enlists the mysterious Count Adelman as her protector. Ninenya must now work with Adelman to improve her poor health and stop her from becoming the victim of a deadly family feud.

"Please don’t touch the guy wearing glasses…"
Department head Kim, who quit his job as a special agent only for his daughter Minji and chose to be normal. Then one day, Minji disappeared silently, and Manager Kim began to find his daughter by turning the country that monitors him into the enemy.
description.ko:
제발 안경 쓴 아저씨는 건들지 말자.
오직 자신의 딸 '민지'를 위해 특수요원직을 관두고 평범함을 선택한 가장 김부장.
그러던 어느 날 민지가 소리소문 없이 사라지고, 김부장은 자신을 감시하는 국가를 적으로 돌리면서까지 딸을 찾아나서기 시작하는데...

description.ru:
Пожалуйста, не трогайте мужчину в очках.
Менеджер Ким, глава семьи, который бросил работу специализированного агента и выбрал простую жизнь ради своей дочери Мин Джи.
Однажды в один прекрасный день Мин Джи исчезает, не говорив ни слова , и менеджер Ким начинает искать свою дочь, постепенно превращая страну, которая следит за ним, во врага...
description.pt-br: Pai solteiro, gerente de companhia e ex membro das forças especiais. O Sr. Kim vivia uma vida normal até sua filha, Minji, desaparecer. Depois de descobrir que ela poderia estar morta, o Sr. Kim parte em uma busca implacável por informações. Ele irá resgatar Minji a qualquer custo, mesmo que isso signifique destruir tudo e todos que cruzarem seu caminho.

description.en:
Minjun wished for the world to end - until it did. 

When a zombie appears at his door, the bullied teen chooses to fight for survival. Teaming up with Yena, his sassy yet charming classmate, he flees the collapsing city. 

Hunted by the infected and haunted by enemies old and new, they discover that in a world without rules, trust may be their only chance at survival.
description.ko: 가난한 왕따 정민준과 금수저 인싸녀 한예나의 좀비생존기.
description.pt-br:
O mundo caiu. Zumbis vagam pelas ruas. A civilização está desmoronando. E no meio de tudo isso… Um excluído desajeitado, falido e intimidado chamado Jung Min-jun se vê obrigado a se unir à última pessoa que ele esperava: Han Ye-na, uma garota rica e popular que nunca precisou lutar por nada na vida.

Agora, a sobrevivência não se trata apenas de força ou dinheiro. Trata-se de confiança, garra e de superar o fim do mundo juntos. De silêncios constrangedores a batalhas sangrentas, será que essa dupla improvável conseguirá sobreviver ao apocalipse zumbi — e talvez até aprender a se entender no caminho?

description.en:
Gods with everlasting lives. Sura who possess unrivaled power. And humans, caught helplessly in-between.  
When Kubera's peaceful village meets its fiery end, a mysterious magician named Asha comes to her rescue. Together they begin a journey in search of answers and revenge. Meanwhile across the realms, a web of entwined fates is growing tighter. One by one the other players of the game will emerge, each with their own agenda to pursue.  
At the center of this maelstrom stands Kubera, the girl with a god's name. Will this sixteen-year-old be the salvation of the world or its destruction?
description.it:
Dei immortali. Sura dai poteri impareggiabili. E gli umani, che si ergono fra loro impotenti.  
Quando il pacifico villaggio di Kubera incontra la sua fine, una misteriosa maga di nome Asha accorre in suo soccorso. Insieme intraprendono un viaggio in cerca di risposte e vendetta. Mentre attraversano il regno, una rete di destini intersecati sta nascendo… Una ad una le altre pedine della scacchiera emergono, ognuna all'inseguimento dei propri obiettivi.  
Al centro di quest'uragano si trova Kubera, la ragazza con il nome di un Dio. Questa sedicenne sarà la salvatrice di questo mondo… o la sua distruttrice?

Asury z niepojętą mocą  
I ludzie, pomiędzy nimi.  
Gdy wioska Kubery zostaje zniszczona, tajemniczy mag przychodzi jej na ratunek. Razem wyruszają w podróż w poszukiwaniu odpowiedzi i zemsty. Tymczasem pomiędzy wymiarami pajęczyna przeznaczenia coraz ciaśniej zaciska się… Jeden po drugim nowi gracze wkraczają na scenę, mając swoje własne powody. Ianna and Arhad had much in common. They both only cared about themselves, and were madly obsessed with each other. The difference is one wanted the other's warmth, and the other wanted submission.  
  
Though Ianna's life ended in a heated battle against Arhad, the Kingdom's emperor, she is reincarnated into the same life for reasons unknown.  
  
Two people who faced misery in their previous life now have a chance to meet again. Will the same tragedy repeat itself, or can Ianna change the course of history?

description.en:
I possessed the body of the fourth villainess, Shay, who was miserably killed by the other villains for desperately clinging to the male lead.
However, the male lead suddenly offered me an enormous amount of money, in exchange for a contract marriage to help him escape various romantic advances.

"You have to be the most gorgeous and wicked woman in the empire, so that no one will dare to approach me."

...Isn't this marriage a fraud?
Was what I was going to say, but the amount of money he offered was too tempting to refuse. Alright, before the original female lead appears, I'll show them who's the crazy bitch here.

"Dear customer, I'll do my best to help you!"
 
I was confident this was the original plan, however...
This man, whose affection and warmth know no bounds, said he can't imagine a life without me!

I think I somehow ended up getting money, power and even love!

Average college student Yoo Ilhan has always gone through life without being noticed by anyone, even God!

description.en:
I entered a novel in which the heroine who reincarnated as a saintess has to walk on a thorny path.

'Yeah, nope!'

I, who decided to walk on a flower path, abandoned the original frustrating family and adopted my bias as my dad in our first meeting.

"You, be my daddy!"

The story's final boss and villain!
But now he's just my dad. Fufu.
  
"Daddy, why is your name also daddy? So cute."
"What did you eat for breakfast? Handsomeness?"

As I dream of a happy ending for Daddy, there's just one more huge obstacle…  
The existence of the hero who would kill the final boss.

Now that it's come to this, let's save my bias and the hero as an addition! If I have time, maybe the world too! However…

"I'll kill you if you approach my daughter."

…Daddy keeps on raising the death flags.

"You should take responsibility since you tamed me."

Somehow the hero is also obsessed over me, just what's going on…?

description.ar:
خان غو يانتيان عائلته وأصبح جزءًا من طائفة شيطانية في خدمة الشيطان السماوي.
بعد أن أصبح عضوًا في الطائفة، ارتكب العديد من الأعمال الشريرة رغمًا عنه وعاش حياة مليئة بالندم.

حرب الشيطان السماوي العظيمة
انتهت الحرب العظيمة الطويلة والجهنمية للشيطان السماوي بتحطيم وي شوير للشيطان السماوي.
تم القبض على غو يانتيان، الذي ارتكب فظائع، وتم تعذيبه من قبل الطائفة.
وكعمل أخير من أعمال تأنيب الضمير، كشف معلومات عن الطائفة الشيطانية لـ وي شويير، وبعد ذلك مات بعد أن أقسم يمينًا محرمة من الشيطان السماوي.

بعد وفاته، ولسبب غير معروف، يعود غو يانتيان بالزمن إلى اللحظة التي التقى فيها للمرة الأولى بوي شوير.
بعد أن أدرك أن هذا ليس حلمًا، قرر غو يانتيان أن يعيش حياة هادئة حتى لا يفعل أي شيء يندم عليه لاحقًا.
ولكن كما لو كان ذلك حظًا سيئًا، يبدأ الأشخاص من حياته الماضية في الاتصال به واحدًا تلو الآخر، على الرغم من أنه لم يكن لديه أي نية للقيام بذلك.
description.en: Yangcheon Ku, born to the virtuous House of Ku of Sanseo, the Little Star and next Head of House. Status: The world’s most hated demonic martial artist. Cause of death: Defeated during the Virtuous-Demonic War, tortured upon capture. Or so he thought. Moments after dying in the arms of his childhood friend, the Heavenly Sword herself, Seol-ah Wi, he finds himself back in the past. Already things have changed, but is it enough to ensure his second chance at life doesn’t end with the same regrets?
description.ja:
顧雁天は家族を裏切り、天魔に仕える悪魔の宗派に入った。
セクトの一員となった後、彼は自分の意志に反して数々の悪事を働き、後悔の人生を送る。

天魔大戦争。
長く地獄のような天魔大戦争は、魏雪兒が天魔を打ち砕くことで終結した。
残虐行為を働いた谷干天は、宗派に捕らえられ拷問を受けた。
最後の良心の呵責として、彼は魏雪兒に悪魔の宗派に関する情報を明かし、その後、天魔の禁忌を誓って死ぬ。

彼の死後、谷干天はなぜか魏雪兒と初めて会った時にタイムスリップしてしまう。
これは夢ではないと悟った谷干天は、後で後悔するようなことをしないよう、静かに暮らそうと決心する。
しかし、まるで不運だったかのように、そんなつもりはなかったのに、前世の人々が次々と彼に接触してくる。
description.ko:
정파를 배신하고 천마 휘하의 마인이 되어 버린 구양천.
마인으로서 살아가며 천마의 명으로 본인의 의지와는 상관없이 수많은 악행을 저지르고 후회로 점철된 인생을 살아가게 된다.

천마가 일으킨 정마대전.
정파의 삼존 존재마저 무릎을 꿇린 천마를 베어낸 위설아로 인해 길고 길었던 지옥 같은 정마대전에 종지부가 찍히고
마인으로서 악행을 일삼던 구양천은 정파에게 사로잡혀 고문을 받게 된다.
마지막 남은 양심으로 위설아에게 마교의 정보를 넘기던 와중 천마의 금제로 인해 생을 마감하게 된다.

그러나 무슨 이유에서인지 구양천은 과거 위설아와 처음 만났을 시점으로 회귀하게 된다.
회귀가 꿈이 아님을 자각한 구양천은 후회할 짓을 만들지 않도록 조용히 살고자 마음을 먹지만
무슨 일에서 인지 전생에 악연이었던 인물들이 그의 의도와는 다르게 하나둘씩 꼬이기 시작한다.
description.pl:
Gu Yantian zdradził swoją rodzinę i stał się częścią demonicznej sekty w służbie Niebiańskiego Demona.
Po tym, jak został członkiem sekty, popełnił wiele złych czynów wbrew swojej woli i prowadził życie pełne żalu.

Wielka Wojna Niebiańskiego Demona.
Długa i piekielna Wielka Wojna Niebiańskiego Demona zakończyła się zniszczeniem Niebiańskiego Demona przez Wei Xue'er.
Gu Yantian, który dopuścił się okrucieństw, został schwytany i torturowany przez sektę.
Jako ostatni akt sumienia ujawnia Wei Xue'er informacje o demonicznej sekcie, po czym umiera po złożeniu przysięgi tabu Niebiańskiego Demona.

Po jego śmierci, z nieznanego powodu, Gu Yantian zostaje przeniesiony w czasie do momentu, w którym po raz pierwszy spotkał Wei Xue'er.
Po uświadomieniu sobie, że to nie jest sen, Gu Yantian postanawia prowadzić spokojne życie, aby nie zrobić niczego, czego później będzie żałował.
Ale jakby to był pech, ludzie z jego poprzedniego życia zaczynają się z nim kontaktować jeden po drugim, mimo że nie miał zamiaru tego robić.
description.ru:
Гу Яньтянь предал свою семью и стал частью демонической секты на службе у Небесного Демона.
Став сектантом, он совершает множество злых поступков против своей воли и проживает жизнь, полную сожалений.

Великая война Небесного Демона.
Долгую и адскую Великую войну Небесного Демона закончил Вэй Сюэ'эр, разрубив Небесного Демона.
Гу Яньтянь, совершивший злодеяния, был схвачен и подвергнут пыткам со стороны секты.
В качестве последнего акта совести он раскрывает Вэй Сюэ'эр информацию о демонической секте, после чего умирает от клятвы на табу от Небесного Демона.

После своей смерти, по непонятной причине, Гу Яньтянь, переносится в прошлое, в тот момент, когда он впервые встретил Вэй Сюэ'эр.
Осознав, что это не сон, Гу Яньтянь решает вести спокойную жизнь, чтобы не совершить ничего такого, о чем потом придется жалеть.
Но как на зло, люди из его прошлой жизни начинают общаться с ним один за другим, хотя он и не собирался этого делать.
description.uk:
Гу Яньтянь зрадив свою сім'ю і став частиною демонічної секти на службі у Небесного Демона.
Ставши сектантом, він робить безліч злих вчинків проти своєї волі і проживає життя, повне жалю.

Велика війна Небесного Демона.
Довгу і пекельну Велику війну Небесного Демона закінчив Вей Сюе'ер, розрубавши Небесного Демона.
Гу Яньтянь, який вчинив злодіяння, був схоплений і підданий тортурам з боку секти.
Як останній акт совісті він розкриває Вей Сюе'ер інформацію про демонічну секту, після чого помирає від клятви на табу від Небесного Демона.

Після своєї смерті, з незрозумілої причини, Гу Яньтянь переноситься в минуле, у той момент, коли він уперше зустрів Вей Сюе'ер.
Усвідомивши, що це не сон, Гу Яньтянь вирішує вести спокійне життя, щоб не зробити нічого такого, про що потім доведеться шкодувати.
Але як на зло, люди з його минулого життя починають спілкуватися з ним один за одним, хоча він і не збирався цього робити.

description.ar: سيد بيرباز، الذي قاد الحرب التي استمرت 28 عامًا إلى النصر، "آشا بيرباز". بالنسبة لبيرفاز، الذي دمرته الحرب الطويلة، تتوجه آشا إلى العائلة الإمبراطورية لتلقي مكافأة النصر التي وعد بها الإمبراطور. ومع ذلك، فإن المكافأة الوحيدة التي عادت كانت <الحق في اختيار شريك الزواج>. كخيار أفضل، أشار آشا إلى "دوق كارلايل هافن"، وهو الأمير الأول الذي تم حرمانه مؤخرًا من لقب ولي العهد. إذا تم رفضها، كانت تنوي الحصول على نفقة من الإمبراطور... "ماركيز بيرباز. سأقبل عرض زواجك". وعلى عكس التوقعات، قبل دوق كارلايل اختيار آشا. وعود بدعم هائل لبيرفاز...!
description.en:
The lord of Pervaz, who led the 28-year war to victory, Asha Pervaz. 

For Pervaz, who was devastated by the long war, Asha heads to the imperial family to receive the victory reward promised by the emperor.  However, the only reward that came back was the "right to choose a marriage partner." 

As the best choice, Asha pointed out the Duke of Carlisle Haven, the first prince who had recently been deprived of the title of crown prince.  If she was refused, she intended to receive compensation from the emperor... 

"Marquise Perbaz. I will accept your marriage proposal." 

Contrary to expectations, the Duke of Carlisle accepted Asha's choice.  Promising tremendous support for Pervaz...!

---
After winning a long war, Asha Pervaz is expecting the emperor to compensate her with money. Unlike her expectations though, the emperor asks Asha to choose her own husband from a list of nobles. Asha chooses Duke Carlisle Haven, the emperor’s eldest son and former crown prince. Asha expects him to object and pay an alimony instead, but the duke actually agrees to marry her! He even promises to help Asha rebuild Pervaz. What does the duke really want? And will Asha get what she wants without getting embroiled in the growing royal conspiracy?
description.fr: Après avoir mis fin à la longue guerre contre les Lurs, Asha Pervaz, Seigneure des terres de Pervaz, se rend au palais impérial dans l'espoir d'obtenir la récompense promise par l'Empereur. Mais contrairement à ses attentes, Asha ne se voit offrir que le droit de choisir un époux. Fine stratège, elle choisit le Duc Carlisle Haven, fils aîné de l'empereur et prince héritier temporairement privé de son autorité, pensant que celui-ci refusera et lui versera en échange une compensation financière. Mais contre toute attente, le Duc accepte de l'épouser. Il lui promet de lui fournir les matériaux nécessaires à la reconstruction de Pervaz si Asha l'aide à récupérer le trône qui lui revient de droit.
description.id: Setelah kematian ayah dan kakak-kakaknya melawan suku barbar, Asha Pervaz turun tangan untuk menggantikan mereka. Kemenangan berhasil ia raih, namun imbalan yang ia terima hanya cemoohan rakyat dan “hak memilih calon suami”, alih-alih hadiah uang untuk membangun kembali wilayahnya. Sadar bahwa Kaisar mempermainkannya, Asha memilih Carlisle Haven Evaristo, sang putra mahkota kekaisaran yang dicabut haknya akibat skandal besar, untuk menjadi suaminya! Asha yakin Carlisle akan menolaknya, namun…
description.ko: 28년간의 전쟁을 승리로 이끈 페르바즈의 영주, '아샤 페르바즈'. 긴 전쟁으로 황폐해진 페르바즈를 위해 아샤는 황제가 약속한 승전 보상을 받으러 황실로 향한다.   하지만 돌아온 보상은 고작 <결혼 상대 선택권>.  최선의 선택으로 얼마 전 황태자 위를 박탈당한 1황자, '칼라일 헤이븐 공작'을 지목한 아샤. 거절하면 황제에게 위자료를 지급받을 생각이었으나…  "페르바즈 변경백. 그대의 청혼을 받아들이겠다."  예상과 다르게 칼라일 공작은 아샤의 선택을 받아들였다. 페르바즈에 대한 엄청난 지원까지 약속하면서…!
description.th: อาชา เปอร์เวซ ลอร์ดแห่งเปอร์เวซ ผู้นำชัยชยะมาสู่สงครามที่กินเวลายาวนานกว่า 28 ปี อาชามุ่งหน้าไปยังพระราชวังเพื่อรับรางวัลแห่งชัยชนะที่จักรพรรดิได้ให้คำมั่นไว้ โดยมีจุดมุ่งหมายเพื่อนำมาบูรณะดินแดนเปอร์เวซ ซึ่งถูกจักรวรรดิทอดทิ้งจากสงครามที่ยืดเยื้อ แต่ทว่า รางวัลเดียวที่อาชาได้รับกลับเป็น <การเลือกคู่แต่งงาน> อาชาตัดสินใจเลือกมกุฎราชกุมาร ดยุกแห่งคาร์ไลล์ ฮาเว่น ผู้ซึ่งถูกปลดจากตำแหน่งมกุฎราชกุมารเมื่อไม่นานมานี้ ถ้าเธอถูกปฏิเสธ เธอก็จะได้รับรางวัลอย่างงามจากจักรพรรดิ แต่ว่า… “มาร์คกราฟแห่งเปอร์เวซ ข้ายอมรับคำขอแต่งงานของเจ้า” ทุกอย่างกลับไม่เป็นไปตามที่คาดไว้ ดยุกแห่งคาร์ไลล์ ฮาเว่นเลือกที่ยอมรับคำขอแต่งงานของอาชา และเขายังสัญญาที่จะให้การสนับสนุนเปอร์เวซอย่างเต็มที่อีกด้วย
description.tr: Perbaz’ın 28 yıl süren savaşı zafere taşıyan lordu ‘Asya Pervaz’. Uzun süren savaşta harap olan Pervaz için Asya, imparator tarafından vaat edilen zafer ödülünü almak üzere imparatorluk ailesine gider. Ancak kendisine geri dönen tek ödül <Evlilik eşi seçme hakkı> olmuştur. Asya en iyi seçenek olarak, yakın zamanda veliaht prens ünvanından mahrum bırakılan ilk prens olan ‘Colail Haven Dükü’nü işaret etti. Eğer reddedilirse, imparatordan nafaka almaya niyetliydi… “Markiz Pervaz. Evlilik teklifinizi kabul ediyorum.” Beklentilerin aksine Colail Dükü, Asya’nın teklifini kabul etti. Pervaz’a büyük destek sözü verdi!..
description.vi: Lãnh địa Pervaz đã bị tàn phá bởi một cuộc chiến tranh. Và vĩ lãnh chúa mới của lãnh địa Pervaz này chính là Asha Pervaz. Cô được hoàng đế ban thưởng cho chiến thắng của mình. Nhưng người gặp cô lại chế giễu cô là ‘nàng công chúa man rợ’ và thật là một đề nghị vô lý khi trao quyền chọn bạn đời làm phần thưởng cho chiến thắng. Asha phải đưa ra lựa chọn tốt nhất ngay cả trong hoàn cảnh này. “Vậy…công tước Carlyle Haven đi” Cô chọn ra đại hoàng tử, người đứng đầu danh sách quý tộc và cách đây không lâu đã gây ra một vụ bê bối lớn và bị tước đoạt danh hiệu đại hoàng tử. Nếu anh ta tức giận và từ chối, cô sẽ nhanh chóng đòi bồi thường sau đó, nhưng đâu ngờ rằng Carlyle lại chấp nhận sự lựa chọn của cô. “Anh mong muốn gì ở tôi?” “Đừng bận tậm đến việc tôi làm ở Pervaz. Đừng mong rằng được đối xử như một người vợ và cũng đừng nghĩ đến việc dính líu đến phe đối lập của tôi. Và khi tôi yêu cầu thì đừng nói linh tinh gì cả, chỉ cần ký vào tờ giấy ly hôn là được” Đó là một giao dịch không có gì là không tốt đối với Asha. Cô nắm lấy tay của kẻ ngạo mạn kia mà ngay cả hoàng đế cũng coi thường. Một nụ cười đầy sức quyến rũ nở trên môi anh. “Phu nhân, sau này xin được giúp đỡ”
description.zh:

在长达28年的战争中，佩尔瓦兹的领主“阿西娅·佩尔瓦兹”成功地率领众人取得了胜利。为了重建因长期战争而荒芜的佩尔瓦兹，阿西娅前往皇室领取皇帝承诺的胜仗奖励。但等待她却只是区区<择偶权>，而无任何实质性的奖励。想到佩尔瓦兹的百姓连今年冬天都可能撑不过去，阿西娅只好选择刚失去皇太子身份的卡莱尔公爵作为结婚对象…“既然皇室不想让我们好过，那么就拉你们一起下水”。
description.pt-br: Depois de vencer uma longa guerra, Asha Pervaz esperava que o imperador a compensasse com dinheiro. Ao contrário de suas expectativas, o imperador ordenou que Asha escolhesse um marido dentre uma lista de nobres. Ela escolheu o Duque Carlisle Haven, filho mais velho do imperador e antigo príncipe herdeiro. Asha esperava que ele fosse contra isso e, ao invés, pagasse uma pensão para ela , mas o Duque concordou em se casar com ela! Ele até prometeu ajudar a reconstruir Pervaz. O que o Duque realmente quer?  E Asha vai conseguir o que quer sem se envolver na crescente conspiração real?
description.zh-hk: 為了拯救因漫長戰爭而荒廢的領地「菲爾巴茲」，亞莎前往皇室向皇帝要求當初所承諾的戰勝補償。然而，她卻只獲得了「結婚對象選擇權」。權衡之下，亞莎認為最好的人選是不久前被剝奪皇太子地位的卡拉爾．海本公爵，假如被拒絕了，就能從皇帝那裡得到精神賠償… 「菲爾巴茲伯爵，我接受妳的求婚。」 出乎意料的是，卡拉爾公爵接受了亞莎的選擇，還承諾提供菲爾巴茲龐大的支援…！

description.en:
One day, Kim Yeondoo, an ordinary high school girl, is suddenly terrorized by her former friend from middle school and stalker in KakaoTalk. In order to stop this, she changes her profile picture to a picture of a random guy and posts him as her boyfriend. But, it turns out that the picture she used is the school's scariest bully, Ji Hyunho?!  
  
As it turns out, the bullies are the tsundere, Ji Hyunho, the smart and cool class president, Seo Juho, and the young man living upstairs of her home, Kang Ahun. Not only that, there's also the My Way baseball boy, Choi Seunghyun, and the pure and lively, Jung Jisung.  
  
How did she end up getting entangled with the handsome bullies?  
  
First place in Apple Store charts in Korea in the debut of the game,  
  
First place ranking in Google Play market,   
  
Along with the achievement of a total of about 2 million downloads,  
  
I really wanted to live as an ordinary female student. Until I met those bastards!!! I became involved with the bullies because of a wrong choice in that one moment!  
  
I AM TARGETED BY THEM!!!

description.es:
Un día, Kim Yeondoo, una chica normal de secundaria, de repente es aterrorizada por su antigua amiga de la secundaria y acosadora en KakaoTalk. Para detener esto, cambia su foto de perfil por una foto de un chico al azar y lo publica como su novio. Pero, resulta que la foto que usó es la del matón más temible de la escuela, ¡¿Ji Hyunho?!  
Resulta que los matones son el soltero, Ji Hyunho, el inteligente y genial presidente de la clase, Seo Juho, y el joven que vive arriba de su casa, Kang Ahun. No sólo eso, también está el chico del béisbol My Way, Choi Seunghyun, y el puro y alegre, Jung Jisung.  
  
¿Cómo terminó enredándose con los guapos matones?  
  
El primer lugar en las listas de éxitos de la Apple Store en Corea en el debut del juego, Primer lugar en el mercado de Google Play, Junto con el logro de un total de unos 2 millones de descargas, Realmente quería vivir como una estudiante ordinaria. ¡¡Hasta que conocí a esos bastardos!! ¡Me involucré con los matones por una decisión equivocada en ese momento!

description.en:
Hanna Yoo: on the verge of giving up her life due to her misfortunes, she is granted another chance through the an invitation to the mysterious Zero Game. Win? She'll be able to create a second life the exact way she wants it to be. And lose? And she'll die for good. With a shaky new partnership, skills to learn, and enemies chasing after her, she must find a way to finish all of the levels and meet the Operator to finally get the life that she wants.  
  
---
  
A fantasy/drama story that follows a young girl as she participates in a survival game with the prize being a chance to rebuild her life to be better than the one she had. And the price of failure being her death.

description.en: Once the bullies target you, it’s game over. The school is run by tyrants whose favorite hobby is tormenting the weakest kids in class. But then Gray arrived. This mysterious new student threatens to dismantle the established order. He may be small in stature, but his calculative and brutal fighting leaves unsuspecting opponents lying on the floor begging for mercy. Now the school's toughest bullies have to scramble to take down this new and unusual hero.

In a world of magic, Russel Raymond, a cursed third-rate mage from a fallen lineage, seeks a new fate. 

Banished from the academy, he scrapes by as a mercenary until his mother’s memento sparks a chance to return to the past. Rewinding to his academy days, Russel receives a new power, igniting his journey to reclaim his honor and rewrite his destiny. 

With this second chance he’s been given, will he finally soar like the dragon he was meant to be?
description.pt-br:
[Você será a base de uma nova mitologia. Te concedo outra chance pelo bem da mitologia.]

O último sucessor de uma família contribuinte da fundação e mago de terceira categoria, Russel Raymond. Ele queria reviver o status social de sua família, mas foi expulso da academia. Tudo o que pôde fazer foi trabalhar como mago mercenário de terceira categoria. Um dia, em seu caminho para um trabalho temporário, o anel de recordação de sua mãe, o "Coração de Dragão", reagiu, e Russel recebeu uma chance inesperada. Ele "regressou" para seus dias de academia.

[Você recebeu uma Pedra Mágica do grau mais baixo (consumível) como recompensa da missão.]

É assim que Russel inicia sua ascendência na vida. Como um dragão que nunca conseguiu abrir suas asas. Ele atravessa as ondas chamadas de destino que o pressionaram e voa para o mundo brilhante do qual uma vez fora banido.

"Are you the one who called me…?"

A black-haired beast looked at him with glowing yellow eyes.

"It’s okay. It won't hurt anymore. You'll be okay."

Estio was born as the youngest son of a farmer, but everyone hated him. He was a child who could read the hearts of people and animals. And…

"A cursed child."

He finally turned 19, and it was now time for his coming-of-age ceremony. Now starts Estio's journey to find happiness.

---
Estio is just an ordinary farmer's son, but with an extraordinary ability-he can read the thoughts and memories of humans and animals. For this, he is shunned by the people in his village, finding happiness only in his animal friends. After years of silently enduring the villagers' hostility, Estio runs away the night he turns 19. His journey brings unexpected friendships and encounters, but will such bonds be able to show him there is more to him and his ability than meets the eye?

description.en:
I, Yoon Seol-woo, a young woman with the ability to see ghosts, was reincarnated as Rosantine, the eldest daughter of a noble ducal house in a world were witchcraft is considered dangerous. I managed to fake not being able to see ghosts somehow but then...

"Leave my sister's body this instant!", I cried out to the evil spirit who's possessed my one and only beloved little sister.

Only the death penalty awaits me if my ability were to be discovered. Then, there's only one way...

"You're planning to kill Prince Chartus, right?"

I will save the Empire's second prince, Prince Chartus with this ability!

"I'll bet my life on Your Highness."

---
Lady Rosentine Arzen was born with the ability to see ghosts, an offense punishable by death under imperial law, and something which threatens to ruin her family. So when Rosentine learns of a plot to poison the imperials, she goes undercover as a vagabond sorcerer to save Prince Charteris Kartazen, who promises to protect her family should she solve the mystery. But who would want to harm the prince? The palace teems with danger, but it’s Rosentine’s own secret that could prove fatal to her.
description.fr: Que feriez-vous si vous pouviez parler aux spectres? C'est le quotidien de Rosantine Arzen, réincarnée dans un monde où la sorcellerie est violemment réprimée. Dans l'espoir de protéger sa sœur et sa famille, elle plonge dans un univers d'intrigues politiques. Heureusement, son don empoisonné lui est d'un grand secours! Mais au sein de la cour impériale et de ses complots, saura-t-elle protéger ses sombres secrets? Et surtout, est-elle la seule à en avoir?
description.id:
"Seorang gadis yang memiliki kemampuan untuk melihat hantu, Yoon Seolwoo, telah bereinkarnasi menjadi Rozentine. Di dunia dia hidup sekarang, dia juga bisa melihat hantu. Akan tetapi, di dunia tersebut, kemampuan seperti itu dilarang dan apabila ketahuan oleh pihak kekaisaran, maka pemilik kekuatan itu harus dihukum mati bersama keluarganya.
Namun, ada jalan lain untuk menyelamatkan dirinya beserta keluarganya dari hukuman tersebut. Rozentine mengetahui dari para hantu, bahwa ada konspirasi yang akan membunuh pangeran ke-2 dengan racun. Jika Rozentine dapat menyelamatkan nyawa pangeran tersebut, mungkin dia bisa meminta imbalan agar dia beserta keluarganya dilindungi.
Bisakah Rozentine menyelamatkan pangeran dan melindungi keluarganya?"
description.ja: 生まれつき幽霊が見えるせいで周りから白い目で見られてきた雪乃だが、ある日突然交通事故で亡くなってしまう。 そして目を覚ますと、アルゼン公爵家の令嬢ロゼンタインに生まれ変わっていた。 前世とは違い両親の愛情を受けながら幸せに育つロゼンタイン。幽霊が見える力はそのままで…。 彼女が暮らすカルタゼン帝国では、呪術を忌み嫌い呪術師を迫害してきた。 ロゼンタインも幽霊が見えるとなれば処刑される道しか残っていなかった。 あることをきっかけに第2皇子シャルトゥスの暗殺計画を知った彼女は、自分と家族を守るため、命をかけて第2皇子暗殺を阻止しようとするが…。

description.pl: "Księżniczka Rosentin!" Odrodziła się jako Rosentin, córka księcia. Z upiornymi oczami. Myślałam, że niebo i ziemia pomogły mi w połowie drogi. "Czarownica to kara śmierci w każdej rodzinie."...? Ludzie, którzy widzą duchy, też są czarownicami. Nie dla wszystkich, ani słowa pomocy. Rosentin tym razem nie mogła umrzeć za darmo i weszła do pałacu, jedynej nadziei na życie...
description.ru:
От Юн Сольу отвернулись все, потому что видела призраков.
И вот её тяжелая жизнь, в которой она продолжала выживать изо дня в день, стиснув зубы, вдруг оборвалась — она умерла бессмысленной и одинокой смертью в автомобильной аварии.
«Госпожа Розентайн!»
Однако она переродилась в качестве дочери герцога Розентайн. Продолжая видеть призраков.
Девушка было подумала, что небеса хоть немного помогли ей, но….
«Говорите, вся семья будет убита, если в ней есть ведьма?..»
description.tr: Ruhları görebilen bir çocuk olan Yoon Seolwoo, hayaletleri görebilen orta çağ asili Rosantine olarak yeniden doğdu! İkinci hayatında hayaletleri görmezden gelmek için elinden geleni yaptı, ama... "Hemen küçük kız kardeşimin vücudunu terk et!" Kız kardeşini bir hayaletten kurtarmak için bunu haykırdı. Eğer yetenekleri keşfedilirse, onun için tek son infaz olacaktı. Durum buysa, kurtuluş için tek bir seçenek vardı. "Prens Schartuze’un öleceğini duydum, değil mi?" İmparatorluğun İkinci Prensi Schartuze’u bu güçle kurtaracağım! "Size hayatımı rehin veriyorum, Ekselansları."
description.uk: Леді Розантина Арджен народилася зі здатністю бачити привидів. За імперськими законами, людей з такими здібностями вважають злочинцями. Покарання – смерть. А для сім’ї Розантини – небезпечна загроза. Тож, коли дівчина дізнається про змову отруєння члена імператорської сім'ї, принца Шартуза Картазена, вона змінює свій вигляд та вдає з себе чаклунку з простого народу, щоб врятувати його. Адже саме він зможе захистити її та її сім’ю, якщо вона розгадає, хто змовився проти нього. Тож, хто хоче вбити принца? Ким є цей таємний супротивник? Палац кишить небезпекою, а таємниці, які приховує Розантина, можуть виявитися для неї фатальними.

I thought my job was done, and just when I was finally trying to go back, the archduke asked me, "Did you really think I wouldn't know that you’re planning on returning to your fiancé?"

description.en: Tludia was on her way to become a Knight within the Order when she was unexpectedly kicked out for breaking too many weapons and – wait for it – eating too much. But that doesn’t mean she should stand idly by when she witnesses an old man about to be attacked by a band of robbers. Luckily for her – because she was a second too late – the old man did not need saving. It’s Tludia that needs saving. Much older than his appearance suggests, Tludia rekindles a long lost memory in him, and he decides to repay her for her efforts by finding a cure for her disease (with promises of food, of course). Thus begins their journey to bring life to one, and long-awaited peace to the other.

description.en:
In a brutal medieval world where innocence means life and guilt means death, Aron, captain of the castle guard, enforces order within the fortress. But when demons begin to corrupt men’s hearts, violent events erupt, including repeated attempts to assassinate the lady of the castle. As Aron hunts the culprits, he encounters a demon that marks him, granting incredible strength but tainting his body with dark magic. Now, with his mind clouded and powers growing, Aron must unravel the mystery before the castle and his soul fall to ruin.

---
In a brutal, lawless medieval world where war and poverty reign, and twisted magic defies all reason, the captain of the guards grinds through another grueling day, pushing his battered body to the limit in a land where survival itself is a merciless test.
description.fr: Aaron se retrouve propulsé dans un monde médiéval fantastique peuplé d’ignares, où le droit du travail n'existe pas. L’infâme ordure des gardes du château Casserdic va devoir tout faire pour survivre dans ce monde de guerre, de magie, de pauvreté... et de démons. Sans oublier, bien sûr, d’éduquer ces abrutis médiévaux.

Mampukah Aaron bertahan hidup di masa ketika hukum dan pandangan moral masih sangat primitif?

---

The beautiful imperial princess of the Brizina Empire, Kasia Miro del Brizina, is rumoured to be a witch, but she just has one tiny wish. To open a doll shop. In order to make it a reality, she calls in the favor of her stepbrother, Emperor Deon.

---
All Casia ever wanted was a happy home and a doll, but the former went out the window when the emperor forced her mother into marriage. Life as a princess was isolating but bearable... that is, until her mother was unjustly branded as a criminal. Now, with the help of her trusted aides, including the youngest prince, Casia is forging her own path outside the palace. As owner of her own doll shop, will she finally be able to escape the imperial family’s clutches and find her true happiness?

description.en:
Bliss has been endlessly reborn and forced to watch the world be destroyed at the hands of Lucas Brandt, king of the demon world. In her most recent life, she comes to... as a newborn baby lying right outside of Lucas' manor! Not only that, but she resembles Lucas so much that she could only be his daughter! Surrounded by Lucas' minions who've slaughtered her in countless past lives, all Bliss can do now is bide her time until she can get her revenge and succeed in saving the world!

---
The world is doomed. Again. No matter how much I regress to try to prevent the end of the world by repeating nearly a thousand recurrences, I could never change the ending. Now, I'm tired. Returning is also boring. How old will I be back this time? Regression, I don't want to do it again.

Dikelilingi oleh antek-antek Lucas yang telah membantai dia di kehidupan sebelumnya, yang bisa dilakukan Bliss sekarang hanyalah menunggu waktu hingga dia bisa membalas dendam dan berhasil menyelamatkan dunia!

O que são essas pequenas mãos? “Quem abandonou este bebê recém-nascido?” Nesta vida voltei a ser um bebê! E também, em frente à mansão de Lucas, o homem que está destruindo o mundo milhares de vezes! description.de:
Als die sechsjährige Inés zum ersten Mal den gut aussehenden Erben von Haus Escalante erblickt, macht sie den Jungen direkt zu ihrem Verlobten. Da alle adeligen Männer bekanntlich gleich sind, dachte sie, sie könnte auch gleich einen gut aussehenden wählen. Aber der kleine Lord Cárcel ist noch nicht bereit für diese Art von Verpflichtung und verbringt die nächsten 15 Jahre damit, die Heirat um jeden Preis zu vermeiden. Glücklicherweise ist das kein Problem für Inés, da das Scheitern ihrer Ehe genau das ist, was sie will. Tatsächlich gibt sie ihm sogar ihren Segen dafür, sich auszutoben, solange er sich nicht in ihre Angelegenheiten einmischt. Leider macht es nicht so viel Spaß, ein Playboy zu sein, wenn die Verlobte einem die Erlaubnis dazu gibt. Und bedeutet das nicht, dass sie ihn auch betrügt? Und so entschließt sich Cárcel, Inés’ Meinung über ihn zu ändern und zu beweisen, dass er der Ehemann sein kann, den sie immer wollte.

As an illegitimate child, Laritte’s biggest sin was being born. In the year she became an adult, she was sent to marry the ghost duke who was rumored to be dead. Her miserable life seemed to get worse and worse, however… Her life changed when the duke came back alive.

“You have enough luxury to buy some residences in the capital.”
“…no one will be able to look down on you anymore.”

Kind servants and the empire’s devoted and murderous duke. It was already too late for those who tormented Laritte in the past to regret their actions.
description.fr: Fille illégitime d’un comte, sa vie est d’abord digne de celle de Cendrillon ! Mais lorsqu’on la marie d’office à un duc présumé mort et traître à la couronne afin de se débarrasser d’elle, elle voit cela comme une chance: enfin la liberté! Certes, elle se retrouve exilée dans un château délabré au cœur des montagnes, sans serviteurs. Mais cela signifie aussi devenir propriétaire de sa maison, pouvoir manger à sa faim, faire ce qu’elle souhaite!!! Seule fausse note: son mari décédé semble être revenu de son voyage dans l'au-delà…
description.id: “Perempuan kotor! Kau mencuri kalungku!” "Kecuali aku tahu di mana kalungmu, aku tidak akan bisa mengambilnya." Sebagai anak haram, dosa terbesar Laritte adalah dilahirkan. Pada tahun dia menjadi dewasa, dia dikirim untuk menikahi adipati hantu yang dikabarkan sudah mati. Kehidupannya yang menyedihkan tampaknya semakin memburuk, namun ... Hidupnya berubah ketika sang duke kembali hidup-hidup. "Nyonya, bagaimana Anda menyukainya?" Pelayan yang baik hati, "Kamu memiliki cukup kemewahan untuk membeli beberapa tempat tinggal di ibukota." “… tidak ada yang bisa memandang rendahmu lagi.” Dan adipati kekaisaran yang setia dan pembunuh. Sudah terlambat bagi mereka yang menyiksa Laritte untuk menyesalinya.
description.ko:

그녀는 태생부터 고귀한 이복언니를 대신하여,

다만, 라인하라트 공작가는 반역죄로 인해 모든 재산이 압류되었으며,
대신 신부로 가게 된 라리트가 향한 곳은 황실의 넒은 아량으로
남겨진 외딴 산속에 있는 낡은 별장이다.

하지만 평생 눈칫밥만 먹던 라리트에게 결혼은 절호의 기회!
지긋지긋한 집을 떠나 드디어 생긴 나만의 집!

늦은 밤, 죽은 줄 알았던 남편이 살아 돌아오는데...?

description.de: Während er im Wald um sein Leben rennt, stößt der unter dem Mobbing seiner Mitschüler leidende Gyuhwan auf eine Schrotflinte und gerade genug Patronen für seine ganz persönliche Rache. Doch das Schicksal nimmt eine unerwartete Wendung, als er zurückkehrt und feststellt, dass seine Klassenkameraden von hirnfressenden Kreaturen angegriffen werden. Das Einzige, was jetzt zwischen den Monstern und ihrem Festmahl steht, ist ein Junge mit einer Schrotflinte.
description.en: While running for his life in the woods, bullying victim Gyuhwan stumbles upon a shotgun and just enough shells for his classmates. It’s a recipe for disaster. But fate takes an unexpected turn when he returns to find his classmates under attack by brain-eating creatures. Now, the only thing that stands in the way of their ravenous feast is a boy with a shotgun.
description.es: Gyuhwan es víctima de acoso escolar. Mientras corre para refugiarse en el bosque, encuentra una escopeta. Hay una bala para cada uno de sus compañeros; la masacre parece inevitable. Pero, al volver, se encuentra con una situación impensada: unas criaturas aterradoras están atacando a sus compañeros... para devorar sus cerebros. Ahora, Gyuhwan y su escopeta son lo único que puede frenar este banquete sangriento.
description.fr: Alors qu'il court pour sauver sa vie dans les bois, Kyu-Hwan, victime d'harcèlement, tombe sur un fusil de chasse. Il pense s'en servir pour tirer sur ses camarades de classe. Mais le destin prend une tournure inattendue lorsqu'il revient et trouve ses camarades de classe attaqués par des créatures mangeuses de cerveau. Maintenant, ce garçon avec un fusil de chasse est le seul qui peut s'opposer à leur festin vorace.
description.id: ''Han Kyu-hwan', seorang anak laki-laki yang tidak punya pilihan selain menjadi pahlawan dari yang lemah, Dan senapan yang dia temukan membuat bocah itu menjadi pahlawan. Prekuel "Sweet Home", yang mencatat 1,2 miliar jumlah total view di global!
description.ja: 実写化『Sweet Home』の前日譚—。地獄を味わったもう一人の少年の話。弱者であった康介は、一丁の銃を手に英雄にならざるを得なかった。
description.th: “ฮันกยูฮวัน” นักเรียนที่ถูกรังแกในห้องเรียน ฝันที่จะแก้แค้นคนที่รังแกเขา รวมถึงเพื่อนร่วมชั้นที่เพิกเฉยต่อสิ่งที่เขาเผชิญอยู่ วันหนึ่ง ณ กิจกรรมเข้าค่ายที่ทุกคนกำลังตกอยู่ในอันตราย ฮันกยูฮวันได้พบกับช็อตกันกระบอกหนึ่งที่สามารถใช้ "ช่วยชีวิต" หรือ "ยิง" ทุกคนได้ เมื่อเขาได้โอกาสที่ฝันไว้มานาน ...เขาจะเลือกทำอะไร?! พบกับ พรีเควลจากเรื่อง !
description.zh:
金坎比实力新作震撼上线！
延续《家》的神级世界观！
表面风平浪静的校园里实则暗潮涌动。欺凌现象比比皆是，故焕就是深受其害的受害者之一。现实生活中迫于各种压力无法反抗的他，有朝一日能否像梦中的自己一样，举起猎枪，勇敢地发起反击呢？
description.pt-br:
Enquanto corre por sua vida na floresta, a vítima de bullying Gyuhwan se depara com uma espingarda e cartuchos suficientes para seus colegas de classe. É uma receita para o desastre. Mas o destino toma um rumo inesperado quando ele retorna para encontrar seus colegas sob ataque de criaturas comedoras de cérebro. Agora, a única coisa que está no caminho de seu banquete voraz é um menino com uma espingarda.

*Obs: Shotgun Boy é uma obra que antecede os acontecimentos de Sweet Home, outra obra do Autor.*

The worst talent that no one can compete with. Unstoppable Demon God, Dan Uhyeon.

A thousand years after being sealed for the misdeed. A thousand years was enough to get rid of Dan Uhyeon's sense of superiority. A world that has changed, solitude with no one knows, and the only thing left is despondency and emptiness.

"Time goes like the wind. There's really nothing left."

A little girl who appeared in front of Dan Uhyeon lost her purpose and will to live aimlessly, Hwa Somi. For a girl who seems to have nowhere to lean on, Dan Uhyeon feels the same and gradually begins to open the door of his mind.

"I'm Dan Uhyeon. Come with me."

The story of a warrior with an icy heart and acute and pure girl The story of an unusual family's life in the midfield will warm your heart.

---
The Ultimate Martial Divine Demon, Dan Woohyun, was sealed up because he was too strong for the world to handle.  After a millennium passed by, he was released from his seal and felt like everything was meaningless as he wandered the back alleys… 

Just as he fell down because he was sick of the world, a small hand appeared in front of him.

"What's this?" asked Dan Woohyun. 

"A dumpling!" came a reply. 

This was the first time in his life that someone had been nice to him without any impure intentions, and that changed his fate. This is the chronicle of a martial god who traversed through a thousand years of time and space!

description.en:
I’ve transmigrated into the world of the BL webtoon <In The House of Dolls, There’s Another Doll Living There> where I left my one and only spiteful comment. On top of that, I become the adopted younger sister of my favorite character: the obsessive male lead who is later regretful for his actions, but still dies along with the duke in the end. So, I was determined. Since I have transmigrated into this world, I can’t stand by and watch my favorite character die. Additionally, I also don’t want to die. That’s why, author, I'll need to change the tags and the ending of this webtoon slightly! From <Obsessive Male lead> to <Considerate Male Lead>. From <Sad Ending> to <Happy Ending>.   
  
“Brother, please smile like that in front of others as well.” I said to Lucian, who doesn’t smile even a little bit in front of others.   
“…”  
  
Was that request too out of the blue?  
Lucian looked at me with a peculiar expression.   
“If you do that, I will give you a gift.”  
I said that because I wanted to help him in anyway I could.   
  
He looked at me for a bit and hesitated before replying, “A gift… Is anything fine?”  
“Of course!”  
The moment I gave that answer with certainty, his expression changed right at once to that of a starving predator… Did I make mistake?  
Then, Lucian calmly replied with an expression full of expectation.   
  
“Give yourself to me, Rachel.”  
Huh? What did he say? What did he just ask for?

Beatty, a weak squirrel shapeshifter born into a lion family. Because of that, she grew up abused in her aunt's home in the capital. When she told her only friend and fiancé, the Second Prince, that she'd be leaving to realize her dreams–

*"Ritter, you bastard…!"*

She died from his poisonous fangs.

"Welcome, Milady!:

"My God! When did you get so tall…?"

When squirrel-shifter Beaty Aslan tells her fiancé, Prince Retter, that she plans to flee her abusive aunt, he unexpectedly kills her with his snake fangs. Upon opening her eyes, she finds herself in the past, before she met that rotten prince. With her knowledge of the future, she sets off to her father's duchy to strike a deal and change her fate, but is surprised to find her lion family welcoming her with open arms. description.fr:
Beatty est une enfant provenant d'une puissante famille de lions métamorphes, cependant elle est née en tant qu'écureuil. Étant séparée de son père et de son frère ainé, elle se retrouve à vivre chez sa tante.

Maltraitée, la pauvre enfant se trouve un ami dans cette tragédie, le second prince, Ritter, qui se trouve être un métamorphe serpent. Elle lui avoue son rêve de partir de chez sa tante à ses 18 ans. Grandissant dans l'espoir d'avoir une vie meilleure, une fois atteint de ses 18 ans tout s'effondre: il s'avère que Liter était du côté de sa tante pendant tout ce temps et qu'il ne nourri aucun sentiment d'amitié à son égard.

Elle meurt, empoisonnée par le venin du serpent.

Grâce à une étrange magie, elle parvient à revenir dans le temps, à une époque où elle vient de rencontrer le second prince, pas de temps à perdre! Elle le gifle et s'enfuit sur ses pattes d'écureuil afin de retrouver son père et son frère.

Déterminée à rester avec sa nouvelle famille, elle trouve toutes sortes de moyens de faciliter la vie de son nouveau peuple.

description.ru:
Бетти – слабая белка-оборотень, рождённая в семье львов.По этой причине она всю свою жизнь прожила, подвергаясь насилию в столичном доме её тети.В тот момент, когда она сказала своему единственному другу и жениху, второму принцу, что хочет уехать ради своей мечты,– «Риттер, ты ублюдок!”Я умерла от его клыков…Но, открыв свои глаза, я вновь оказалась ребёнком, до того, как встретила второго принца.Что нужно в такие моменты больше всего? Скорость.Я немедленно трансформировалась и бросилась на земли своего отца, на территорию льва.Даже если мне будут не рады, я владею величайшим секретом, который раскроется лишь в будущем, и тогда меня не вышвырнут вон…– “Добро пожаловать, госпожа!”– “О, Господи! Когда ты успела так вырасти?..”– “Госпожа, леди подобает ходить на своих двух ногах!”А?.. Почему меня так радостно приветствуют? И это что, моя статуя?!

---
Хрупкая белочка Берти родилась среди львов. Она с рождения жила в доме своей жестокой тёти.
Её единственным другом был будущий жених, второй принц. Но сразу после того, как она решилась бросить всё это ради своей мечты...

— Риттер, ублюдок!..

Он её убил.
Но почему-то она очнулась в прошлом, ещё до знакомства с принцем.
Что в такие времена важнее всего? Правильно, скорость! Она моментально сбежала, прошмыгнув во владения отца.

Ей здесь не рады, но она пойдёт до конца, чтобы раскрыть ужасающую тайну, после которой её ни за что не выгонят.
— Добро пожаловать, леди!
— Господи! Ты так выросла...
— Какие у леди хрупкие ножки.
Какой тёплый приём. Стоп, это статуя в честь меня?!

description.tr:
Beatty yani ben aslan ailesinde dünyaya gelen zayıf bir sincap şekil değiştirenim.
Ancak bazı sebeplerden dolayı başkentte teyzemin evinde tacize uğrayarak hayatımı yaşamak zorunda kaldım.
Tek arkadaşım ve nişanlım ikinci prense hayalimi gerçekleştirmek için gideceğimi söyledim ancak o bana ihanet etti ve…

‘Rither, seni piç..!’

Onun dişlerini boynumda hissederek öldüm.

Gözlerimi yeniden açtığımda çocukluğumda, Rither ile ilk karşılaştığımız zamandaydım.
Böyle zamanlarda neye ihtiyacınız vardır? Tabii ki hız.
Plan yapmakla falan uğraşmadım ve hemen babam Dük Aslan’ın topraklarına kaçtım.

Hoş karşılanmasam da gelecekte keşfedilecek olan bu büyük bir sırrı bildiğim için…

“Hoş geldiniz leydim!”
“AMman tanrıçam! Ne ara bu kadar büyüdünüz…?”
“Leydim tombiş ayaklarıyla yürüyor!”
Ha? Neden böyle karşılandım?

Olmaz, bu benim heykelim mi?

Sincap Beatty’nin hikayesi ile yeni serimiz sizlerle!

description.uk:
Бетті - слабка білка-перевертень, народжена у сім'ї левів. Через це вона прожила своє життя у знущаннях в столичному будинку своєї тітки. Коли вона сказала своєму єдиному другові та нареченому, другому принцу, що йде, аби здійснити свою мрію, то загинула від його ікл. 
Вдруге розплющивши очі, Бетті розуміє, що потрапила у своє дитинство, у часи, коли ще не була пов'язана зі своїм нареченим Ріттером. 
Що ж катастрофічно необхідне в такий час? Швидкість. 
Вона негайно втекла на території свого рідного батька, герцога Лева. Як би її там не зустрічали, але вона твердо вирішила приховувати свою таємницю, аби її не вигнали. 
«Ласкаво просимо, міс!»
«О Боже! Коли ви так виросли...?» 
«У юної леді такі миленькі малесенькі ніжки!»
… Га? Чому мене так вітають? Не може бути, це що, моя статуя?!

description.vi:
Beatty là một bé sóc con yếu ớt được sinh ra trong một gia đình sư tử. Chính vì điều đó nên nàng luôn bị dì ruột của mình ngược đãi ở Thủ đô. Và khi nàng nói với người bạn duy nhất của mình kiêm vị hôn phu – Nhị hoàng tử rằng mình sẽ rời khỏi nơi này để thực hiện ước mơ.
“Ritter, tên khốn nạn này…!”
Thì nàng đã chết trên chiếc răng nanh sắc nhọn của anh ta.
Và rồi khi tỉnh dậy lần nữa nàng thấy mình đã quay về lúc nhỏ, khi nàng chưa dính dáng gì đến Nhị hoàng tử này.
Vào những lúc như thế này thì chúng ta nên cần gì? Chính là tốc độ.
Ngay lập tức, nàng rời khỏi giường và chạy đến lãnh thổ của cha nàng, Công tước Sư tử.
Mặc dù biết rằng mình sẽ không được hoan nghênh, nhưng nếu nàng nắm trong tay một bí mật khổng lồ trong tương lai thì chắc rằng họ sẽ không đuổi nàng đi đâu…
“Hoan nghênh người đã trở lại, tiểu thư!”
“Chúa ơi, người đã lớn như thế này rồi sao…?”
“Nhìn kìa, tiểu thư đang bước đi với đôi chân dễ thương!”
… Hả? Sao nàng lại được hoan nghênh nồng nhiệt như thế chứ?
Không thể nào, bức tượng kia chẳng phải là nàng sao?

description.en:
Even though the harsh reality feels like living as a beggar, to think that the end would be death from overworking!
If it’s going to end like this, I should’ve been in a lot of relationships, but wait,
oh my... who are you in the mirror?

I’m a little flustered but this body… it’s really pretty!
It feels like I’ve been transmigrated into a romance fantasy novel.
Since I’m already like this, should I enjoy the romance while I’m at it?

“But which novel did I get transmigrated into?”

I’ve read dozens of books where the ‘Northern Duke’ and ‘Childhood Friends’ exist,
I’ve read so many with a black-haired male lead and a blonde female lead,
Ah~ I don’t know!! For now, let’s start by conquering the male characters!

“I already have a promised marriage."

“I volunteered for the Western Guard. We won’t be able to meet for several years.”
What is this, is this really a romance fantasy novel? Why is everyone running away?!
In the first place… was I really transmigrated as the female lead?

What kind of novel is this!!!!
<It Seems I’ve Transmigrated Somewhere>

description.en:
Dayeon is… tired. She’s so tired that she’s been transported to a new world and she’s still too tired to do anything. But most of all, she’s tired of Emperor Mikhail’s near-constant attention! He’s just so perfect… always concerned about her well-being and shielding her from the church’s attempts to label her some kind of saint. And he keeps finding reasons to brush her hair behind her ear or stare dreamily into her eyes. How’s a girl supposed to sleep through all this endearingly loving attention?!

---
Feeling hopeless in a cold-hearted society, I arrived in a different dimension, Altius Empire! It’s the first oracle in 32 years and there’s nothing I can do to meet the expectations of the Empire’s citizens. There’s nothing different in this world. The cold treatment is no different from the previous world. After a series of disappointments swept through, what came after was fatigue and lethargy. I don’t want to do anything. I’m not doing anything but I don’t want to do anything more intensely. Even so…

Among the citizens of this new world, a red robed mysterious man seems capable of wielding extremely powerful magic in a way that should not be possible. It's unknown what his aim is or what he wants to accomplish. All that's known about this mysterious person is that he has been using forbidden level spells to kill evil-doers throughout the city.

description.de: Im Kampf um Liebe und Thron wird Yurina Cartia von einem mächtigen Magier, der ihrer Rivalin dient, ermordet. Als sie in der Vergangenheit erwacht, bietet sich ihr jedoch eine neue Chance. Nun muss sie es schaffen, ihr Schicksal zu ändern und diesmal die Hauptperson der Geschichte zu werden. Wird sie den Magier dazu bringen, diesmal für sie zu kämpfen? Wird es ihr gelingen, zu überleben und ihr Schicksal zu beeinflussen?
description.en:
“You must save me in the future, just like how I saved you today.” 

After a hit-and-run accident, I possessed the body of young Yurina Carthia, the villainess of the novel who was brutally murdered by the second male lead. 

Looking for a way to save myself as Yurina and fumbling to remember the contents of the story, I decided to find the second male lead, the character who will kill Yurina in the future, from the orphanage, sponsor him, and pull him to my side. 

“Remember, Yurina. I am the only one who can save you or kill you. So you have to stay by my side.” 

I just wanted to survive, but I raised an obsessive second male lead!

---
After being reincarnated as the villainess of a novel, Yurina is determined to escape her fate of being killed by the story’s second male lead. Her solution? Save his life and get him on her side before he falls in love with the female lead! Her recollection of the story is spotty, but after months of searching, Yurina finally finds him-- or so she thinks. He’s a bit different from what she expected, but that’s probably because of her poor memory... Her plan should still work, right?
description.fr: La vie de Yoon Séna est bouleversée quand elle se retrouve projetée dans son roman préféré suite à un accident de voiture. À son grand étonnement, elle se réveille réincarnée dans le corps de Yu Ri Na, la vilaine du roman! Si elle ne change pas le cours de l'histoire, elle finira assassinée par le plus grand mage du royaume, amoureux de l'héroïne. Sa seule solution: faire de son futur bourreau son fidèle servant et échapper à une fin tragique! Yoon Séna réussira-t-elle à réécrire l'histoire?
description.id: Setelah aku meninggal karena kecelakaan, aku masuk ke dalam tubuh Yurina, antagonis wanita yang nantinya akan dibunuh oleh pemeran pendukung pria dalam sebuah novel. Aku hanya menjalani hidup sebagai Yurina sambil mengingat kembali isi novel dan mencari cara agar bisa bertahan hidup. Tapi... "Ingatlah, Yurina. Orang yang bisa menyelamatkan dan juga membunuhmu hanya aku saja. Jadi kamu harus ada di sisiku." Aku justru membuat pemeran pendukung pria menjadi obsesif.
description.it: Dopo essersi reincarnata nella cattiva di un romanzo, Yurina è determinata a sfuggire al suo destino di essere uccisa dal secondo protagonista maschile della storia. La sua soluzione? Salvargli la vita e portarlo dalla sua parte prima che si innamori della protagonista femminile! I suoi ricordi della storia sono lacunosi, ma dopo mesi di ricerche, Yurina finalmente lo trova, o almeno così crede. È un po' diverso da quello che si aspettava, ma probabilmente è a causa della sua scarsa memoria... Il suo piano dovrebbe comunque funzionare, giusto?

description.en:
I've reincarnated as the young daughter-in-law of a villain who was taken in for his deceptive plans. The problem is that I'm terminally ill, so I'm going to die when I become an adult.

"Luckily, I know how to cure it, but..."

If I don't die at the right time, my father-in-law—no, the villain, Duke Ecarde—might kill me just to achieve his goals!

But what kind of kid could actually adjust to this kind of household?

"I want to live happily with Father and Evan for a long time... cough! Cough!"

Me. I'm "that kid."

---
The final villain is being deceived by his young time-limited daughter in law who was possessed. If I die at the right time, I will marry his son. The problem is, I already know the cure! And I don't want to die, but if I don't get killed now, then I won't die quietly.

"Daddy, I love you so much. You are the most handsome man in the world. Cough, cough!"

"Evan, shall we read a fairy tale book together until we fall asleep?"

She will have to act a little better to let his guard down. Then, she would be able to do a great job.

I think I'll have to leave secretly after I get better. I have to make a lot of money and buy land under pseudonyms.

"Call all the council members on the continent. My daughter-in-law has to live."

Father? Shouldn't I be thrown away…?

"If you die, I'll follow you unconditionally. I can't live in a world without you."

Husband? You’re acting strange, too… You don’t love anyone, do you?

Even- "Who is this, Kyle Ravonis? The man who seduced my daughter-in-law deserves to die."

"Even if you cheated on me with another man, I will never break up with you."

You must have misunderstood my other name!

"When did this start, huh? You said you wanted to live as a sweet couple, but you tried to run away by creating a new identity behind our back?"

I want to quietly disappear, not die! I didn't know my husband, who has been like a friend to me ever since we were young, would come to me with such sore eyes.

"You're still my wife on paper. Live as my wife, and die as my wife."

"Evan?"

"You've shown me both heaven and hell…" his reddened eyes locked me up, "You'll never get away from me no matter where you go."

---

She has everything to prove. He must pretend to be another.

In this Empire where everything is about appearance, she is the scapegoat for the whole people.
Everyone believes she is cursed because of the color of her hair: black raven hair symbolizing the devil and his curse.
Her opponent as Empress is her opposite and has silver hair. 

In this world, appearances are very often misleading…

---
Born ever so gracefully, but destined to be a disgrace. The Grand Duke's daughter Evelyn la Royceite of the House of Royceite was promised to a graceful life from her birth. And yet Her dark-colored hair and eyes made her repulsive by the people of the Theian Empire since they were considered as an ominous sign.

Despite all that, her family makes her attend the debutante hosted by the emperor to change her misfortune.
On that day, Evelyn meets the daughter the Grand Duke of Ansian, the heiress to the rival House of Casablanca and by far the most beautiful girl that Evelyn has ever seen. Witnessing the hostility and discomfort at the debutante, Evelyn decides to put an end to her miserable life as a caged crow in the house of noble and pursuit her long lost dream of living the wanderlust life as a hired sword.

After a few years later, an unexpected person visits at her doorstep.

description.en:
***This is a promotional oneshot for a novel of the same name.***

---
I lived suffering without a home, religion, or parents, but an angel appeared and reincarnated me.

"You, a pro when it comes to romance fantasy novels, would you like to reincarnate in a world that was created based off of a romance fantasy novel?"

I reincarnated because he said I would have a (handsome) dad and a (handsome) older brother who would spoon feed me, and even gift me a diamond mine, but… –I might be a child from my mother's affair? As soon as I was born, I was sent to my mother's household and fell into a family that deprives me.

"If I stay like this, I might end up freezing or starving to death by myself!"
description.es:
Vivía sufriendo sin padres, ni familia ni hogar y murió. De repente apareció un ángel y le ofreció reencarnar.

‘’Tú, una amante de las novelas de fantasía romántica (Rofan) ¿Te gustaría reencarnar en un mundo que basado en ellas?’’ 

Terminó reencarnando porque dijo que tendría un padre y hermano (guapos) que tendría una vida llena de lujos, e incluso le daría habilidades especiales, pero…. 

¿Podría ser hija de la aventura de una noche de mi madre?

Nada más nacer la confiaron a la familia de su madre y sufrió de maltratos.
  
''¡Mierda, maldito demonio estafador! ¡¿Dónde está mi lujosa vida con un padre y hermano guapos y amorosos?!'' - Dijo frotando el amplio suelo del salón de la casa de su tío, el marqués Tarenka con sus manos enrojecidas e hinchadas por el frío. Su tío, aborrecía la existencia de su sobrina por lo que desde que nació en este nuevo mundo, la trato como una esclava.

Cuando por fin aparece su 'padre' el duque de Paeraton, decide que es su última oportunidad para escapar del infierno donde vive, así que se aferra a su pierna implorando.

‘’¡Papá, llévame!’’ - Sobrevivamos de alguna manera.

‘’Si permanezco aquí, puedo morir de frío o hambre’’ - No se puede evitar 


Ahora empieza su nueva vida con su familia, pero ¿Será de verdad hija de duque Paeraton? ¿Por qué no se parece en nada a él?

Además, para obtener lo que desea debe usar la 'habilidad especial' que le dieron ¡Pedir y pagar! Pero para pagar debe cumplir misiones para tener efectivo… ¡Ningún lector de Rofan han tenido este tipo de misiones!

¿Cómo hará para sobrevivir en este peligroso mundo basado en un Rofan?
description.ko:
집도, 절도, 부모도 없이 살다가 고생만 하며 죽었는데 천사가 나타나 제안했다.

“로맨스판타지 소설의 프로베댓러인 당신, 로판을 참고해 만든 세계에 환생하지 않겠습니까?”

(잘생긴) 아빠에, (잘생긴) 오빠들이 다이아 수저로 맘마를 떠먹여 준대서 환생했더니….

—엄마가 바람피워서 낳은 자식일지도 모른다고요?

태어나자마자 외가에 맡겨져 구박데기 신세로 전락했다.

‘이대로라면 혼자 얼어 죽거나 굶어 죽을지도 몰라.’

이렇게 된 거 어쩔 수 없다.

“아빠, 나 데려가아—!”

어떻게든 살아남아 보자.
그런데,

[조건을 충족했습니다.]
[특성 를 각성합니다.]

[독자님, 원하는 것을 얻기 위해선 수단과 방법을 가리지 마십시오.
정복하고 쟁취하십시오!
로판 독자는 이런 상황에서 뒤로 물러나지 않습니다!
당신의 능력을 보여주세요!
-조건: 파에라톤 공작을 설득해 를 획득.
-보상: 5,000캐시 뽑기권
-퀘스트 거절 패널티: 인생 하차
-퀘스트 실패 패널티: 인생 하차]

‘그러니까 퀘스트가 아빠 볼따구에 뽀뽀하는 거라고요?’

…사기 당했다.

*

아레스가 내게 다가왔다.
“오늘 정말 귀엽네, 내 동생.”
“뭐, 약골 솜뭉치 주제에 봐줄 만은 하네.”
익시온이 질세라 다가오며 말했다.
“벽이나 부수는 저런 폭력적인 놈 말은 들을 필요 없어.”
“아아, 속이 시커먼 놈보단 낫겠지.”
“네게는 여전히 교육이 필요한 것 같구나.”
“지금이라도 해볼 테냐?”
두 사람의 눈빛에서 살기가 일렁이기 시작했다.
아니, 또 이 패턴이냐.
이제 나도 안 말려!
싸울 거면 나가서 싸워!
내 방 부수지 말고! 나는 유일한 희망인 아빠를 바라봤다.
과연 아빠는 침착한 얼굴로 나를 바라보고 있었다.
하아, 역시 안심된다.
어느 때에도 냉철한 우리 아빠!
내가 활짝 웃으며 아빠에게 손을 뻗는 순간.
“……두렵군.”
아빠가 살짝 비틀거리며 중얼거렸다.
“내 딸의 귀여움은 신체를 장악할 정도다.”
……예?
“일시적 마비. 그 직후 비정상적으로 빠르게 일어나는 심실과 심방의 수축과 팽창.”
“…….”
“팔다리가 뇌의 통제를 잃고 멋대로 움직이려고 하지.”
척, 어느새 다가온 아빠가 나를 번쩍 안아 들었다.
저기요, 딸 안아드는 게 팔다리의 통제 운운할 거리인가요.
나는 짜게 식은 눈으로 아빠를 내려다봤다.

-------------------------------------

캐시를 뽑아 로판을 소환하자!
아기부터 시작하는 이세계 캐시 라이프!

description.ru:
Она прожила очень трудную жизнь без крова и родителей, а когда умерла, к ней пришёл ангел с интересным предложением: «Не хотели бы вы возродиться в фэнтезийном мире, созданном по романтическому роману, преданным комментатором которого вы и являетесь?»
Он сулил ей (красивого) отца, (красивых) братьев, не чаявших в ней души…
А на деле никто не знает, рождена она плодом супружеской верности или измены.
Как только малышка появилась на свет, её оставили семье матери без какой-либо поддержки.
«Такими темпами я умру от холода или голода.»
Ничего не поделаешь.
«Папа, забери меня!»
«Надо как-нибудь выжить.»
Однако…
**[Все условия выполнены.]**

**[Награда: 5000 наличкой.]**

**[Наказание за провал: смерть.]**

description.en:
Living for the sole aim of escaping!

‘Light of Rusbella’ was a depressing romance novel. Wishing for a new life, Asili Rosé was reborn as the 8th wife of the Estrian Emperor. She thought she was born with a golden spoon, but it was actually just a gilded spoon? Once she realized that nothing but ruin awaited, she found a diary foreshadowing the future…

It foretold Asili’s death by the hands of the Crown Prince, Castor!
  
[“What does the empire mean to you?”
After asking this, the Crown Prince smiled so very beautifully. And then he killed me.]

Unfortunately, Asili kept coming back to life, and continued to be killed over and over again. As she continued to relive her deaths, she slowly lost her smile and changed.

…Let’s try to survive first.

---
“What can I do for my elder brother?”

---
Pale sky blue hair fluttered finely in the wind. He smiled weakly, before parting his dry lips.

“Call my name.”

“…”

My head quickly snapped up.

“Call me… Amoru.”

His fingertips skimmed along my inner wrist.

---

The doctor advised Yeon Soo to walk for ten minutes a day as an exercise.  
And while she started to exercise on an impulse with the man with a limited time(?), 'Han Gyul', who was admitted next to her in the hospital,  
Somehow she felt her heart flutter…?  
  
Enjoy the freshness of an older female lead that unexpectedly gets her heart bombarded by a younger man!
